arena: [분담] Blessing of Sanctuary instantly removes all stun, silence and fear effects from an ally and reduces the duration of those effects by 60% for 5 sec. Put it on your healer immediately when they're caught in an enemy CC chain.

[분담] Blessing of Spellwarding makes an ally immune to magic damage and harmful effects for 10 sec, and Blessing of Protection makes them immune to physical damage, but they share a cooldown. Pick one based on whether the enemy burst is magic or physical.
[생존기] Divine Protection can be used while stunned and reduces all damage taken by 20% for 8 sec. Press it when you take burst while stunned.
[생존기] Divine Shield makes you immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec. Save it as your last resort against burst no other defensive can survive.
[차단] Rebuke interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Hammer of Justice stuns a target within 10 yds for 6 sec. Pop Avenging Wrath and burst while the enemy healer is locked down.
[제어] Searing Glare replaces Blinding Light: after a 1.25 sec cast, enemy players in a 25 yd cone miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec. Use it when enemy DPS pop their burst cooldowns.
[해제] Cleanse Toxins removes all poison and disease effects from an ally. Take over poison and disease dispels for your healer.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 5-6 DPS; healers carry the flag first, or a mobile DPS if none can. Keep up with and protect the carrier using Divine Steed's 100% movement speed for 3 sec.
[분담] Blessing of Freedom makes an ally immune to movement impairing effects for 8 sec. Put it on your flag carrier when they're held by slows.
[분담] With Hallowed Ground, Consecration removes and suppresses all slows on allies in its area. Drop it where your team stacks in base teamfights or on the flag carrier path.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Divine Protection's damage reduction right before the burst.
[제어] Searing Glare was picked by 32 of 46 Battleground Blitz players and makes enemy players in a 25 yd cone miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec. Aim it at enemy DPS stacked on a base.
[우선 처치] Stun the enemy flag carrier for 6 sec with Hammer of Justice to buy time for your team to catch up and kill them.

Hallowed Ground, picked by 39 of 50 Solo Shuffle players, removes and prevents slows on allies in Consecration. Blessing of Spellwarding and Searing Glare, each picked by 32 of 46 Battleground Blitz players, give an ally magic immunity and make enemies miss their spells and attacks, respectively.
